home.realConditionsBody: Kepler's SAT practice runs in a full exam interface — the same tools, pacing, and pressure you'll face on the real thing. No surprises when it counts.
home.countdownTimerBody: Practice with real exam timing and build confidence under pressure.
home.reviewMistakesBody: Return to questions you answered incorrectly, understand what went wrong, and avoid repeating the same mistake.
home.vocabDeckBody: Save unfamiliar words while practicing and review them later with your personal vocabulary deck.
home.questionNavigatorBody: See answered, unanswered, and flagged questions at a glance and jump to any question instantly.

deckDemo.vocabExampleA: “She kept meticulous notes throughout the experiment.”

home.whySubtitle: Everything you need to turn practice into a better score.
home.benefitPracticeBody: Work through realistic questions designed to match real exam formats.
home.benefitProgressBody: See how many questions you've solved and where you're improving.
home.benefitExplanationsBody: Understand every answer with clear, step-by-step explanations.
home.benefitFocusBody: Identify the areas that need more practice and study smarter.
home.howSubtitle: From sign-up to score improvement in four steps.
home.step1Body: Sign up with your email in a few seconds.
home.step2Body: Start with SAT or DIM practice sets.
home.step3Body: Work under real, timed exam conditions.
home.step4Body: Read explanations and revisit weak topics.
home.faq1Q: Which exams can I practice on Kepler?
home.faq1A: SAT and DIM practice are available today, and TOEFL is coming soon. You can see the full list in the Exams section above.
home.faq2Q: Does it feel like the real exam?
home.faq2A: Yes. SAT practice runs in a timed, exam-style interface with a passage pane, mark for review, answer elimination, a question navigator, and a final review screen before you submit.
home.faq3Q: Do I get to see why an answer was wrong?
home.faq3A: After you submit, Kepler shows a full answer review — your answer, the correct answer, and a step-by-step explanation for each question.
home.faq4A: Your exam attempts and scores are saved to your account, so you can retake an exam and compare your results over time.
home.finalBody: Create a free Kepler account and begin your SAT practice today.

footer.blurb: Kepler helps students prepare for SAT, TOEFL, and DIM with realistic exam-style practice, detailed explanations, and progress tracking.
footer.tagline: Built for students preparing for SAT, TOEFL, and DIM.
